4399-4518-4924-8333.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Heartless Summoning.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Sickbay triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Sickbay trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sickbay trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-4924-8333.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

719-4881-6909-8200.manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
719-4881-6909-8200.description:
Cast Grub's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1750-2793-5131-5261-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1003-4053-6495-6989.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
1003-4053-6495-6989.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4019-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3944-5660-5684.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
When Blood Pet enters, Metastatic Evangel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1661-1987-4423-7434.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Brass Infiniscope.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
1661-1987-4423-7434.notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

4659-7282-7320.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Servo Schematic.
When Servo Schematic enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Servo and the Servo Schematic token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Servo Schematic triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1350-4010-6723-7297.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {4}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and four Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, four Halflings and four Foods by tapping them, adding {6}{G}{W}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-6723-7297.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

628-3967-7214.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

851-1563-1849-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

539-3519-6879--142.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Ally in your hand.
539-3519-6879--142.description:
Cast the Ally by paying its mana cost.
When the Ally enters as a Forest due to Ashaya, Haru triggers, earthbending the Ally.
Activate the Ally by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the Ally, adding an amount of mana of any color equal to the Ally's mana value plus one that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Haru triggers, returning the Ally from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2510-6867-7043.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-6867-7043.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-2438-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1605-3693-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Gratuitous Violence.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2103-2974-6689.easyPrerequisites: You control four or more artifacts.
2103-2974-6689.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing it to exploit itself. Its second ability then triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Golbez's second ability triggers, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

654-2608-2882-6644-6798.manaNeeded: {G}{W}{U} plus an additional {1} if you've cast Derevi from the command zone this game
654-2608-2882-6644-6798.description:
If you haven't cast Derevi from the command zone this game, cast it by paying {G}{W}{U}. Otherwise, activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it from the command zone onto the battlefield.
Derevi enters the battlefield as a copy of Ancient Adamantoise due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Derevi.
Choose to return Derevi from your graveyard to the command zone.
When Derevi dies, it triggers, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}{U}.
Repeat.

1580-4647-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

813-1567-4377.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Walk the Aeons and Momentary Blink.
813-1567-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons and Momentary Blink from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

5026-6452.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
You have enough mana to cast Reverberate
5026-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Reverberate, with the copy targeting the original Reverberate.
Resolve the copy of Reverberate, copying the original Reverberate, with the copy targeting the original Reverberate.
Repeat step 5.

488-2478-2895-4211-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Mishra's Bauble or Tormod's Crypt must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-2478-2895-4211-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-3090-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
2034-3090-5434-5555.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

586-3771-3967-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
586-3771-3967-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3372-4050-5223-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
3372-4050-5223-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

575-997-1207.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-997-1207.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1418-3484-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
1418-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

199-3946-4426.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

3263-5231-5433.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3263-5231-5433.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Repeat.

2433-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature, or have a way to remove Lonis and/or Rosie from the battlefield.
2433-5365.description:
Cast Rosie by paying {2}{W}.
When Rosie enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a Food artifact token.
Rosie's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat from step 3.
2433-5365.notes: Once you would like to break the combo, you may use Rosie's trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on any creature you control except Lonis, or you may remove Lonis and/or Rosie instead. A failure to break the combo will force the game to end in a draw due to a mandatory infinite loop.

1045-2292-4424.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
1045-2292-4424.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Horde Ambusher.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1328-2103-2276.notablePrerequisites: Spellbinder attached to a creature that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1328-2103-2276.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Said without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Said, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

600-1180-3334.description:
Cast Nicol Bolas by paying {U}{B}{B}{B}{R}.
Nicol Bolas enters the battlefield with five loyalty counters due to Lae'zel.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it.
Nicol Bolas dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Nicol Bolas ability, creating two non-legendary copies of Nicol Bolas, which enter with five loyalty counters each due to Lae'zel.
Repeat from step 3 using a Nicol Bolas token.
Once you have infinite Nicol Bolas tokens, you may activate them using Jace's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from them, creating infinite 2/2 Illusion creature tokens.
You may also use Nicol Bolas' first ability to draw infinite cards, and exile all permanents your opponent control.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1061-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least eight other permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you do not have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token's ascend ability triggers, causing you to get the city's blessing for the rest of the game.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1309-3617-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
1309-3617-3742.description:
Cast Time Walk, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets that is tapped and attacking.
Salvager of Secrets enters, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

7-539-1899-2232-3703.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter among creatures you control.
7-539-1899-2232-3703.description:
Cast Beastcaller Savant for {G}, triggering Sporemound and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger choosing not to return another permanent.
Resolve Sporemound's trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling token triggers Cloudstone Curio.
Tap Beastcaller Savant, adding {G}.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand.
Repeat.

1283-1987-2427-2493.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.

738-1778-1969-5256.description:
Sacrifice Memnite to Altar of Dementia.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Memnite to your hand.
Resolve Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
